payload.name: Aggregate repeated location visits into count memory
payload.description: Use when a subject's visits/trips to the same city, country, or place are mentioned across multiple messages, and a memory storing the total number of visits should be created or updated.
content: When extracting candidates from a message, if the message describes a visit or trip to a location already mentioned as visited by the same subject in an existing memory, extract a candidate that records the total number of visits to that location (or updates an existing visit-count event), not only a new separate event.

During CRUD, when a candidate or existing memory contains a visit to a location and another memory records a different visit to the same location by the same subject, update or merge into one event memory that explicitly states the combined visit count.

solves: When a person's visits to the same city or country appear in more than one message, the extraction stage often records each visit as a separate event and never stores the total count, so later count questions cannot be answered from memory. This Skill instructs the agent to aggregate repeated location-visit mentions into one explicit count memory (or update an existing one), making visit-count facts durable and queryable. It applies during candidate extraction and during CRUD when merging memory candidates.
